method.name: print_run_lab_estimates_v1
method.calibration: Print Run Lab weighted-median fit of 1 Topps pack formats to numbered anchors. Only rows passing the leave-one-anchor-out stability rule (per-card change <= 5% in every refit) are published. Provisional; not manufacturer-confirmed.

lab_provenance.source_membership_assumption: All listed subjects eligible in each mapped parallel; individual autograph availability can vary.
lab_provenance.numbering_policy: Only official NumberedTo values are anchors. Blank ordinary autograph is not /199. Estimated packed counts remain distinct from nominal ceilings.

calculation.assumptions: Default model: each format’s pack total is the WEIGHTED MEDIAN of its numbered anchors’ implied packs (implied packs = eligible subjects × serial × odds, less any fixed-format contribution), weighted by each anchor’s influence so base/insert anchors outweigh autograph/memorabilia. Each parallel’s estimate = packs ÷ odds ÷ eligible subjects. A dash means unavailable; anchors with an infeasible implied pool are excluded. These are estimates from published odds anchored on known serial numbers, not manufacturer-confirmed totals.
